name: Bachelor of Science in Engineering in Civil Engineering
faculty: Faculty of Engineering & the Built Environment
notes: Band C FPS 420 (possible admission; SA applicants in targeted redress categories only) with Maths 80% & Physical Sciences 70%. Band A (guaranteed): FPS 500+ with Maths 80% & Physical Sciences 70%. Band B (likely): WPS 480+ with Maths 80% & Physical Sciences 70%. No English percentage printed for this programme (English still counts in the FPS). NBTs (Mathematics, AL & QL) must be written but are not used for admission in this faculty. All BSc(Eng) students start on the 4-year curriculum; after the first 5 weeks some are advised to move to the 5-year extended (ASPECT) programme with extra Maths/Physics support (no separate application). ECSA-accredited (Washington Accord). New project-linked curriculum since 2025.

name: Bachelor of Architectural Studies
faculty: Faculty of Engineering & the Built Environment
notes: Band C FPS 348 (possible admission; SA applicants in targeted redress categories only) with Architecture Portfolio Score 50%+. Band A (guaranteed): FPS 450+ and portfolio 75%+. Band B (likely): WPS 408+ and portfolio 68%+. All applicants must submit a portfolio of prescribed creative exercises by 31 Jul 2026 (same as general closing date). English printed as 50% (HL or FAL not specified; 50% applied to both). Leads to BAS Honours and Master of Architecture (professional); graduates may register with SACAP as Candidate Architectural Technologist. NBTs (Mathematics, AL & QL) must be written but are not used for admission in this faculty.
